service.name: testServiceInterface
service.description: This has test service specific attributes; most of the important information comes from standard service attributes, including: - responseMessage: success, error, or fail - errorMessage, errorMessageList, errorMessageMap: where messages will comes from for error or fail responses - successMessage, successMessagesList: where messages will comes from for success responses

service.name: purgeOldTestReports
service.description: Deletes runtime/test-reports/<date>/<run> folders older than the test.report.retention.days SystemProperty (default 30), always keeping the last test.report.retention.keep.last.n.green (default 5) fully-passing runs per suite. Scheduled daily by the TESTREPORT_PURGE JobSandbox entry seeded in TestReportsScheduledServiceData.xml.
